focus.title: Steady toss height
focus.whyChosen: It comes early in your serve, so fixing it often helps what follows. Your toss peaked at clearly different heights. Even allowing for measurement error, it was more scattered than typical. It fits your goal: more first serves in.

sentences: When the toss peaks at a different height each time, your swing has to re-time itself on every serve. Coaches work on this first, and experienced servers keep toss height steadier than any other part of the toss.

cue.text: Every toss peaks at the same spot.

drill.title: Same-peak serves
steps: Make 5 tosses, taking the racquet back as you toss each one, then catch the ball or let it drop.
Serve 20 balls at a comfortable pace, swinging at every toss, even the imperfect ones.
After each serve, note whether you had to wait for the ball or chase it, and count the ones where you did neither.
Finish with 10 serves alternating T and wide, without counting.
